semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Hakuto Taiwan Ltd. acts as a distributor for various semiconductor equipment and vacuum-related products, which are essential in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hakuto Taiwan Ltd. is a global trading company specializing in the distribution of semiconductor equipment and vacuum solutions. They represent a portfolio of well-known products, providing comprehensive service and support through their established service network.
capabilities: Distribution of turbopumps and rotary vane pumps
Supply of helium leak detectors and vacuum measuring devices
Provision of vacuum pumping stations and leak test systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: Hakuto Taiwan Ltd. operates as a distributor within the Taiwanese semiconductor market.
